description: The best-ranked car deals in one market right now: the top deals overall, then SUVs, trucks, sedans, hybrids and cars under $20,000. Each car comes with its price, how far under its market price it is, and its link. Use it for 'what are the best car deals in Pittsburgh' or 'best used car deals near Dallas'.

condition.description: Only new or only used cars. Leave out for both.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets, for example 'pittsburgh-pa'.

name: best_deals
title: Best deals in a market
